title: Quick Fried Crispy Middle-Eastern Meat Kibbeh Patties
description: A crispy and flavorful kibbeh patty dish from the Middle East, made quickly with white bread mix, onions, and spices.
instructions: Preheat a clay pot or a cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Mix together the white bread mix, onion, beef mince, eggs, flour, paprika, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the melted butter to the bowl and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small oval patties.
Dust the patties lightly with flour and place them in the preheated clay pot or cast-iron skillet.
Fry the patties for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the patties from the clay pot or cast-iron skillet and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Drizzle the fried patties with olive oil and serve immediately.
Serve warm with your choice of salad or flatbread.
